cohort: This study included 87 pregnancies in 61 HIV-infected women who received care at the HIV outpatient department and gave birth at the Department of Obstetrics at University Hospital Bonn between 2005 and 2016.
finding: There was no vertical HIV transmission from mother to child observed in the study, and the elective cesarean section rate and rate of premature births decreased significantly due to changes in treatment strategy.
mod_finding: The study found that the elective cesarean section rate fell significantly from 77% in the years 2005-2011 to 58% in 2012-2016.
birth_weight: The birth weight of 78% of newborns was between the 10th and 90th percentile between 2005-2011, increasing to 92% after 2012.
